artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing the upper half of a seated female figure. She is positioned facing forward, with a slight turn of the head to her left. Her facial features are rendered with fine lines, including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a small, slightly curved mouth. Her hair is styled elaborately, with tight curls and adorned with a jeweled crown. She is dressed in richly detailed garments featuring a high ruffled collar and patterned, voluminous sleeves. Interlocking necklaces or embellishments drape across her chest, and a large chain hangs with an ornate pendant resting at the center. In her right hand, she holds a scepter while her left hand holds a royal orb. The background of the image is an ornate frame with heraldic crests in each corner, and a central arch above her head. Two cherubs are depicted sitting atop the arch. The bottom of the artwork contains an inscription in an embellished script, identifying the figure, along with ornamental designs of mythical creatures at the sides of the frame.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a woman seated and positioned frontally, slightly turned to her right. She has an elongated face with delicate features, styled hair adorned with a crown, and wears an elaborate lace ruff around her neck. The ornate gown she wears is richly decorated with intricate patterns and textures, including embroidered sleeves and a decorative bodice. She holds a scepter in her right hand and an orb in her left. The image is framed by an oval border with Latin inscriptions referencing her titles. Above her, two cherubs are seen on either side, with two coats of arms in the upper corners. The background shows a detailed architectural setting with decorative elements complementing the central portrait.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person, showing their head and shoulders. The person faces forward with their head slightly turned. They have distinct features such as a prominent forehead, high cheekbones, refined eyes, a straight nose, closed lips, and short, styled-back hair. The person is wearing a large ruff around their neck and a dress with a high collar, along with a small rounded hat. There is no visible jewelry. The background is an oval frame with text reading "MARIA STUART D. G." and "SCOTIA REGINA." The portrait is enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a person from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the right. The person has a solemn expression with finely etched facial features, including a narrow chin and high forehead, framed by hair styled closely around the head and covered by a cap. They are wearing a high-collared garment adorned with a wide, pleated ruff around the neck. A necklace with a cross pendant hangs around the neck. The background features a decorative frame with elaborate scrollwork, and text at the bottom states "Maria Stuarta, Scotia Regina, Gallice dotaria."

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image features a historical illustration of a woman standing. She is holding a cross-like object in her right hand and a staff with a fleur-de-lys design in her left. Her face has large eyes, slightly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a small mouth, framed by a decorative headdress. Her hair is styled in tight curls with an ornamented headpiece. She wears an elaborate garment with a high lace ruff collar, fitted bodice, ornate patterns, and three crowns above her head. The attire includes fur trimmings and detailed embroidery. In the background are heraldic symbols, including two shields with intricate designs. Latin text is inscribed below her portrait, indicating her royal heritage. The background is detailed with patterned lines for depth.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman depicted from the waist up, positioned at an angle with her left hand resting on a surface. Her facial features include a serene expression with slightly downturned eyes and a firm-set mouth. Her hair is styled under a decorative cap adorned with lace, and a high lace ruff surrounds her neck. The woman wears a richly detailed, long-sleeved gown with intricate patterns and a structured bodice. A cross-shaped piece of jewelry hangs from her neck, and lace details adorn her sleeves. The background features draped fabric. The text below the image reads "MARIA SCOTORUM REGINA."

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The person is in a three-quarter view, looking to their left. They have a high forehead, prominent eyes, a slightly upturned lip, and short, curled hair. The person is wearing a garment with an elaborate ruffled collar and a triangular hat. The background features an engraved circular frame with the text "MARIE STEWART REYNE DE FRAN ET DESCOSSE," and intricate hatching for texture. Below the frame is a block of engraved French text surrounded by a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person portrayed as Princess Mary, Queen of Scotland, and Dowager of France. She is depicted facing forward, holding a scepter in one hand and an orb in the other. Her facial features include arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and medium-length hair styled under a crown. She wears a ruffled collar, an intricately detailed gown, and a crown decorated with elaborate embellishments. Shields topped with crowns are on either side, symbolizing her royal status. The background features a dark circular pattern, enclosed by an ornate oval border.

artworks.title: Mary, Wife of William II of Orange
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a young girl shown from the knees up. She is standing in a poised manner, with her left hand resting on a ledge or table covered with a fringed cloth. Her facial features include a delicate, oval face adorned with soft, wide eyes and a calm expression, while her wavy hair cascades down to her shoulders, decorated at the top with a small headpiece resembling a crown or tiara. She is dressed in lavish attire, with an intricately detailed gown featuring lace trimmings and puffed sleeves. Around her neck, she wears a necklace made of round beads. The background is composed of intricately detailed architectural elements, including pilasters and decorative arches.

artworks.title: Mary of Modena, as Duchess of York
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Banck after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length portrait of a woman standing with one hand on draped fabric, and her other arm on an ornate pedestal. She is facing forward, with softly rendered facial features, defined eyebrows, a small nose, full lips, and hair styled in tight curls. She wears a detailed gown with voluminous sleeves, an embroidered hem, and pearls around her neck. Beside her, a large vase of detailed flowers and foliage is displayed. The background includes heavy drapery with tassels and a large column.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, seated with one hand on an open book. His facial features include a serious expression, thin lips, prominent cheekbones, combed-back hair under a hat, and a high-collared garment with visible ruffled collar layers. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with Latin inscriptions, flanked by two angels holding trumpets on each side. The background features a family crest at the top, with intricate detailing, including angelic figures, scrolls, and flowers. The lower section includes Latin script.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated in a formal position, his body turned slightly to one side with his gaze directed outward towards the viewer. The man has a long, pointed beard and a mustache, with hair that is mostly covered by a cap that has a flat top. His facial expression is calm and serious, with lines visible on his forehead and around his eyes. He is wearing intricate clothing typical of the period, including a high, ruffled collar, a richly textured robe over a patterned vest, and puffy sleeves. In his hands, he is holding a book. The engraving includes a decorative oval frame with text surrounding his portrait, indicating his identity as "TOBIAS MATTHÆUS." The background is a simple pattern of horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Matthias, Roman Emperor and William I, Princeof Orange
artworks.description: In the image, two men are depicted in ornate oval frames from the waist up. Both men are standing formally, with one having short, curly hair and wearing armor with detailed patterns, and the other having short hair, a beard, and a mustache, also dressed in intricate armor. The background features decorative elements such as coats of arms, figures holding scrolls and musical instruments, and Latin inscriptions. The engraving is intricate and formal in style.

artworks.title: Emperor Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed mustache and small goatee, a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, and curly hair. He wears a laurel wreath on his head and is dressed in a detailed outfit with a high lace ruff, fur-lined cape, and a chain with a pendant around his neck. The portrait is within an oval frame with an inscription, set against a background of hatch patterns. Below the oval, there is a block of text in elegant writing.

artworks.title: Matthias, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man sitting on a throne, shown in three-quarters view. He is holding a scepter in one hand and resting the other on an orb on a draped table. The man has defined facial features with a mustache and beard, styled hair, and rich, ornate clothing including a high lace collar and a jeweled, embroidered robe with a chain across the chest. He wears a crown with intricate detailing and there is a large crown on the table. The background has dark, patterned drapery and curtains partially open to reveal a patterned window.

artworks.title: Emperor Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to his right with a dignified pose. The man has an angular face, a trimmed mustache and goatee, and short, combed-back hair mostly covered by an ornate crown. He wears a richly decorated outfit with a high ruff collar, a chain with a medallion, and an embellished cloak. The background consists of engraved lines, creating a textured backdrop. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame with text identifying the man as Matthias I. Additional text beneath the portrait identifies him as an emperor and king of various regions.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man in an intricately designed frame with detailed engravings. He is positioned facing forward with a slight turn to his right. His hair is short and wavy, and he has a mustache and goatee. He wears a ruffled collar, a garment with decorative elements, and a sash. The background consists of cross-hatched lines. Below the portrait, there is some Latin text.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, positioned slightly to the side but facing the viewer. The man has an oval-shaped face with prominent cheekbones and a slight smile. He has deep-set eyes beneath arched eyebrows, along with a beard and mustache. His hair is curly and styled upwards, shorter on the sides. The man is wearing a detailed garment, possibly a mix of metal and fabric, with a large, ornate ruff around his neck. The portrait is encased in an oval border with text and emblematic elements like shields and lions. The background features intricate line work.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: This is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and a slight goatee, with wavy hair and a distinct hairline. He is depicted wearing decorative armor and a detailed collar with a frilled edge. A coat of arms is displayed in the top left corner of the image. The background consists of fine lines, and the bottom of the engraving features inscribed text identifying the person, likely with their title and name.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a bust portrait of a man shown from the chest up, oriented forward. The man has distinctive facial features, including a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a pointed beard and mustache. His hair is styled with a slight wave and a short, voluminous cut. He is wearing ornate clothing typical of the late Renaissance or early Baroque period, featuring a high-collared shirt with intricate embroidery and detailed patterning, possibly armor with buttons and etched designs. Surrounding the portrait is an oval border with an inscription. The background is a simple, dark texture that contrasts with the figure, emphasizing his detailed features and attire.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse. The man is on the back of the rearing horse, facing the viewer with a confident expression. He has an angular face, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and styled hair. He wears ornate armor with a breastplate, shin guards, and a high ruffled collar. A decorative plume flows from his helmet, and a large cloth billows behind him. In his right hand, he holds the horse’s reins, and in his left hand, he holds a baton pointing upwards. A coat of arms is displayed in the top right corner. The background features buildings and geographical features, giving the impression of an elevated view. Various figures are engaged in activity at the lower section of the image, depicting a scene of battle or fortification.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.2 x 14.2 cm (7 3/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He is posed with his head slightly turned to the right, his left hand on his hip and his right hand holding a long rod or baton. The man has short, curly hair and a neatly groomed beard. He wears intricately designed armor covering his whole body, including a high lace ruff around his neck and armored boots. He has a calm expression. Beside him, a large shield with a coat of arms rests on the ground. The background shows a detailed scene of a battle or military encampment, with troops and structures.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man with a well-defined face, a small goatee, and neatly groomed facial hair. He has curly, short hair and is dressed in period attire with a high lace collar and a textured cloak. The background features a circular format with a Latin inscription. Below the portrait is decorative script.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual is positioned facing slightly rightward, with their gaze directed at the viewer. Their facial features include a stern expression with a lined face, a beard, and mustache, and wavy, combed-back light hair. The clothing is ornate, with a richly embroidered or patterned sash across one shoulder, a high-tiered ruffled collar, and a dark outer garment. The person wears a round medallion or pendant around their neck. The background is a simple texture, and the portrait is encased in an oval frame. The bottom of the print includes the text "MAVRITIVS NASSAVIVS, PRINCEPS AVRIACVS, etc.," with small decorative elements on the sides.
